instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade Brazilian Portuguese SaaS dashboard + WhatsApp AI bot simulator for LAD Delivery v1 resale.
Dark mode by default: integrate Tailwind v4 theme in frontend/src/index.css with dark background #0B0F17 and WhatsApp green #25D366 highlights.
Support complete multi-tenant multi-store management: each store stores its LAD API token, name, phone, bot prompt, status (online/offline/token_error), and simulated/live order log.

Provide mock + live LAD Delivery v1 integration: GET /v1/loja, GET /v1/cardapio, POST /v1/frete, POST /v1/pedidos (with idempotencyKey), GET /v1/pedidos/{uuid} with all 8 color-coded statuses (E, A, V, X, D, P, C, R).

Build the WhatsApp Chat Simulator with authentic WhatsApp Web dark theme: wallpaper doodle background, green bot bubbles, gray customer bubbles, timestamp receipts (double blue check), typing indicator with animated dots, and tool call pill chips (e.g., '🤖 Executando: /v1/cardapio...', '📍 Calculando frete: /v1/frete...').

Integrate the Gemini 3 Flash LLM / bot simulation engine capable of autonomously picking items from the active store's menu, calculating CEP delivery fee via /v1/frete, confirming payment method from /v1/loja, and generating real order payloads.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for robust Playwright testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or flat gray backgrounds without visual hierarchy.
Use 2-3x generous spacing with crisp 1px borders (border-white/10 or border-slate-800) and backdrop blur.
All interactive elements must have hover and focus states with clear contrast.
Do not use emojis for icons: use Lucide React icons exclusively.
Use Sonner for toast notifications (toasts for token verified, order created, store saved).
